elements.element: P1. Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly states that Customer is not liable for any liquidated damages, penalty, or similar charge for late payment; only simple interest may apply.

elements.element: F1. Any Customer-payable liquidated amount is only an early-termination fee.
elements.evidence: No Customer-payable liquidated amount remains in the rendered clause, so the condition is absent.

elements.element: F2. The early-termination fee is capped at three months of fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes no early-termination fee; therefore, there is no such fee requiring a cap.

elements.element: F3. The early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by Customer.
elements.evidence: No early-termination fee or other liquidated amount is payable by Customer, so the condition is absent.
